record.erasure: Change whether the payload's opening is kept, and the id stays.
record.sets: Change the order of, and repeats in, about, prev, erases or sets, and the id stays.
write.checked: write succeeds exactly when every check passes, and what it returns carries the proof.
payload.read: A stored opening supplies the top-level fields of its payload. Reading depends only on that payload. A held non-object supplies no fields.
record.refuse: Writing refuses a bad envelope, an invalid salt length, a repeated member name, or a nonfinite or out-of-range number. Every number's magnitude must be at most 2⁵³ − 1, whole or not.
thing.one: A record is of exactly one thing: what its of names, read as written, or without of its own id. A thing's heads are records of it, so a record heads at most one thing.
thing.local: Change the records not of this thing, once records are settled and admitted, and this thing's state stays.
admit.no-cross: Every held record an admitted record's prev names is of the same thing, and may be replaced by it: prev never crosses things.
thing.mentions: Change what records mention in about, and the things and each thing's heads stays.
input.union: Change which place is read first, and the union stays.
settle.set: Change which place holds which form, and what the reader keeps (one record per id) stays.
view.no-resurrection: Change which payloads a reader holds, and the set of heads, by id stays.
result.unread: A fold does not guess. It counts the records whose test is unknown and the selected records it cannot read.
spec.parse: An accepted spec's parsed form parses back to itself, and the parser gives exactly the specs that fit.
spec.select: Change which payloads a reader holds, and the set of records a spec's from takes stays.
spec.from-thing: from's of takes exactly the records of the thing, a root by its own id. from's about takes exactly the records that mention it, as written.
spec.set: Change the order the records arrive in, and every slot of every spec stays.
spec.after-supersession: A slot over heads returns only records that remain heads of at least one thing. Each returned record passes from and every test.
spec.follow: Count, sum, min and max that follow prev fold every current record and nothing else: the whole-reader heads, each id once. They choose heads as latest-by does: from and the envelope tests choose, the payload tests filter.
keyed.select: Heads choose, each alone: a thing is kept when from and the envelope tests choose one of its heads and its payload tests hold of the thing, with its whole keyed state. A payload test is asked of every live setter of its field; one answer from all of them is the answer.
by.set: Change the order the records arrive in, and every group of a slot with by, its keys, its unread and its ungrouped stays.
by.accounting: Every record a slot with by selects, or whose where is unknown, is exactly one of grouped, ungrouped or unread. The groups hold each grouped record once per key.
acc.set: Change the order, for any step that commutes, and the state stays.
heads.set: Change how the records arrive, the set kept, and any answer worked out from the heads stays.
latest-by.converge: Change which way two places sync, and the state both reach stays.
keyed.cut: Change whether a reader holds a part closed downward of a closed holding whose writers followed the rule, or only that part's live records, and what the part reads: each key's live setters, and the heads stays.
cut.prefix: Every prefix, the records emitted before a time, is closed downward exactly when no record names a record with a later emitted.
result.canonical: Two runs of one spec, over any records and under any rule for who may replace whom, have the same canonical text, bytes and preimage of the hash exactly when their results agree once what is shown is set aside.
tick.inputs: Change which holder replays the claim, and the canonical result bytes stays.
tick.made: A tick made with a fitting spec checks same on the writer's holding, including after appending outside forms that erase no covered id.
tick.canonical: A fitting written payload reads back under its own rules in spec slot order, with listed ids shown here. Every successful common read excludes repeated names throughout. Equal JCS texts of finite accepted inputs have equal wire values, including array positions and scalar tokens.
lens.round-trip: Render, then parse, and you get back what you rendered.
lens.absence-not-edit: Change the text by dropping a section, and that section of the state stays.
batch.refuse-order: Change the draft order and the order each stage finds its refusals in, and the refusal reported stays.
settle.keeps: A payload any place holds is kept, unless it is erased.
settle.erased: Once a record naming it in erases is held, every form of its target is erased.
admit.set: A record is refused exactly when it isn't entitled to its prev, and that depends only on the set.
where.total: A test answers for every record whose payload is here, and an envelope test for every record at all.
view.refines: Hide payloads and a where answer stays, or becomes unknown.
where.fields: kind and observer read as their text; about, of, prev, under and erases as their members, of as written and absent on a root; emitted as its instant.
latest-by.order: The winner is a head: nothing about its thing names it in prev. It is newer than every other head by content order: span, then emitted, then id.
keyed.live: A setter of a key is live for it when no record above it over prev sets the key. Every record sets the envelope, so live for the envelope is a head. A record is live exactly when it is live for some key, the envelope among them.
keyed.slots: Count, sum, min, max and collect that follow keys read things. Count counts each selected thing once, however many of its heads are chosen. Sum, min and max read the field from its one live setter. Collect lists exactly the selected things' live records, a pure-join head among them; its limit counts things, each listed whole.
by.after-admission: Settling, admission and the whole-reader heads are worked out once, over everything held, before any group. Each group is the unmodified slot over all of it, with its selection narrowed to the group.
by.partition: A grouped count's groups, ungrouped and unread add up to the value and unread of the same count without by, when every selected record has at most one key.
keyed.by: A slot with by that follows keys groups things. A payload key is read from each live setter of the field; an envelope key from each chosen head. Every selected thing, or one whose tests are unknown, is exactly one of grouped, ungrouped or unread.
lens.escaping: Any body survives rendering and parsing, backslashes and all.
lens.refuse: Malformed text, empty section ids and repeated section ids are refused.
lens.put-get: An edit that keeps exactly the base's sections, in the same order, applies exactly.
latest-by.set: Change how the records arrive, the set kept, and every thing's state (its heads and winner) stays.
